reason: The cited evidence supports that Nb-Ti binaries outperform Nb-Ta and that Ti-rich multi-component alloys can have higher upper critical fields, but it does not directly demonstrate that increasing Ti in a HEA enhances disorder or that such disorder increases Tc via modified electron–phonon coupling; the mechanistic link is speculative.
premises: Binary Nb-Ti alloys exhibit better superconducting properties than Nb-Ta
Titanium-rich ternary/quaternary Nb-Ti-Hf and Nb-Ti-Ta alloys show the highest upper critical fields
Increasing Ti content in HEAs will enhance local compositional disorder and lattice distortion
Enhanced disorder modifies electron–phonon coupling and density of states at the Fermi level
This modification increases Tc and possibly the upper critical field relative to Nb-Ta based HEAs
